journey.name: Backing up the log, and the log as a spreadsheet
journey.description: A month after the first thing trained with no backup (or a month after the last one, with something new since), Today asks to back up the log: Export offers the export file to share or save and the ask goes; Not now asks again in a month. Settings' Export says when the log was last backed up. Export a spreadsheet offers the log as a CSV, a row for each workout, sport day, Lift session and set, which opens in a spreadsheet and is no backup. Needs a log with something trained more than 30 days ago and no export since (adb shell's date, or a fresh install with an imported file of old workouts).

actions.action: Open the app on Today and verify that a card "Back up your log" shows with "Export" and "Not now"
Tap "Export" and verify that the share sheet offers interval-YYYY-MM-DD.json; save it to Files or Drive
Go back to Today and verify that the card is gone
Open Settings and, under "Your data", verify that Export reads "Last backed up" with today's date

Tap "Export a spreadsheet" and verify that the share sheet offers interval-log-YYYY-MM-DD.csv; open it in a spreadsheet app and verify a header row (Date, Time, Kind, Name, Exercise, …) and a row for each workout, session and set, weights in the unit the app weighs in
